maintenance_items.label: Engine oil and filter
maintenance_items.description: Drain old oil, replace oil filter element. Crucial for lubricating engine, transmission, and wet clutch.

maintenance_items.label: Valve adjustment
maintenance_items.description: Valve adjustment maintains proper compression and prevents premature wear on the cylinder head.

maintenance_items.label: Air filter
maintenance_items.description: A dirty air filter reduces power, increases consumption, and can damage intake sensors.

maintenance_items.label: Spark plugs
maintenance_items.description: Worn spark plugs increase consumption, make starting difficult, and can damage the ignition coil.

maintenance_items.label: Coolant
maintenance_items.description: Coolant loses its antifreeze and anticorrosive properties over time, potentially damaging the engine's internal circuit.

maintenance_items.label: Timing chain
maintenance_items.description: Check automatic tensioner wear indicator and chain slack. Replace if stretched to avoid catastrophic failure.
